data.description:
Painter - All in One (SPT 4.0)

Overview

Ivan “Painter” Samoylov is a custom trader for SPT who specializes in supplying rare tactical components used throughout my custom mods.

Painter - All in One combines multiple standalone trader mods into a single package, making installation easier than ever.

This release includes:

  • Tactical Gear Components (TGC)
  • BlackCore
  • Mag Tape

There is no longer a need to install these mods separately. Simply install Painter - All in One and you’ll have access to all of the above through a single trader.

Painter unlocks at Player Level 1 and features balanced progression designed to fit naturally into SPT.

What’s New

  • Merged Tactical Gear Components, BlackCore, and Mag Tape into a single mod.
  • Only one installation is required.
  • Updated for SPT 4.0.
  • Painter’s questline is fully functional.

Features

  • Unlocks at Player Level 1
  • Includes:
    • Tactical Gear Components (TGC)
    • BlackCore
    • Mag Tape
  • Fully functional questline
  • Balanced loyalty progression
  • Compatible with SPT 4.0

Loyalty Levels

Loyalty Level Player Level Sales Sum Standing
LL1 1 0₽ 0.00
LL2 9 500,000₽ 0.08
LL3 18 1,300,000₽ 0.16
LL4 30 3,000,000₽ 0.22

Installation

  1. Download the latest release.
  2. Extract the archive.
  3. Place the Painter folder into your SPT/user/mods/ directory.
  4. Launch the game.

Compatibility

  • ✅ SPT 4.0
  • Works as a standalone trader.
  • Designed to support my MoxoPixel’s weapons, armor, and attachment mods.

FAQ

What is Painter - All in One?

Painter - All in One combines the following mods into a single download:

  • Tactical Gear Components (TGC)
  • BlackCore
  • Mag Tape

This means you only need one installation instead of three separate trader mods.

Credits

Original Creator: MoxoPixel

All credit for creating Painter goes to MoxoPixel.

This SPT 4.0 release merges the component trader mods into a single package while updating Painter for compatibility with the latest version of SPT.

Known Issues

This is a large compatibility update, and with multiple mods being merged into a single package, some items may still have missing icons, incorrect models, textures, or other unexpected issues.

If you encounter any problems, please report them on GitHub or the mod page. I’ll do my best to fix any major bugs and broken items as quickly as I can over the coming days.

Thank you for your patience and support!

versions.description:
**Update v1.0.1**

**Fixes**

Fixed an issue where raids could fail to load due to the error:
Item template 'LOOTCONTAINER_SPORT_BAG' not found in ItemTpl class
Corrected the invalid static loot container reference that was preventing raid generation.

**Additions**

Added Ammo Pouch and First Aid Bag to Secure Containers.
Added world spawns for a selection of helmets, rigs, and backpacks sold by Painter, allowing them to be found naturally during raids.

As always, thanks to everyone who reported issues and provided feedback!
